overview.more:
People choose Whitefield for a simple reason: it is where the work is. Tech parks, the Purple Line metro extension, and years of IT-driven growth have made it one of the most sought-after locations for software professionals and students moving to East Bangalore. The trade-off is a competitive rental market where quality can vary significantly between a landlord-run PG and a professionally managed residence. This page explains what a Colive PG in Whitefield offers, typical pricing, available room types, and how to book your stay. For a broader overview of the locality, read our ultimate guide to living in Whitefield.

Why Whitefield Is Bangalore's Most In-Demand PG Location

Whitefield sits on Bangalore's eastern edge and functions as a self-contained work-and-live district. The biggest pull is proximity: most residents are within a 5–15 minute commute of a major tech park, which is exactly why PG demand here outstrips almost every other corridor in the city. Add the metro, the malls and the hospitals, and you rarely need to leave the neighbourhood on a working day.

Tech Parks Within a Short Commute

Approximate drive times from central Whitefield (ITPL Main Road). Confirm against your own address before booking -peak-hour traffic on the Whitefield–Varthur stretch can double these.

  • International Tech Park Bangalore (ITPB / ITPL) -approx. 5 minutes
  • EPIP Zone -approx. 5–10 minutes
  • GR Tech Park, Whitefield -approx. 10 minutes
  • Sigma Tech Park & Brigade Tech Gardens -approx. 10–15 minutes
  • Prestige Shantiniketan business hub -approx. 10 minutes

Metro, Rail and Road Connectivity

  • Whitefield (Kadugodi) Metro -Purple Line, a direct run to KR Puram, Indiranagar, MG Road and Majestic
  • Hope Farm and Channasandra metro stations -alternative Purple Line access points
  • KR Puram Railway Station -approx. 8–12 km for outstation and suburban trains
  • BMTC buses along ITPL Main Road, Whitefield Road and the Outer Ring Road
  • Kempegowda International Airport -approx. 40–50 minutes via the airport road, traffic depending

Lifestyle, Shopping, Healthcare and Education

Daily life rarely requires a trip into the city. Whitefield's retail and weekend options are clustered close together:

  • Malls and retail: Phoenix Marketcity (Mahadevapura), Nexus Shantiniketan and VR Bengaluru -cinemas, food courts, supermarkets and groceries under one roof
  • Everyday essentials: supermarkets, pharmacies and cafés around ITPL Main Road, Hope Farm junction and Borewell Road
  • Hospitals: Manipal Hospital Whitefield, Vydehi Institute of Medical Sciences and Sri Sathya Sai hospitals
  • Education: Vydehi, colleges along ITPL Road and several international schools in Kadugodi and Varthur

Newcomer tip: the Marathahalli–Varthur–Whitefield road carries the heaviest evening traffic, so a PG on the same side as your office saves you a daily 40-minute crawl. For a block-by-block read on rents and connectivity, see our rental trends in Whitefield guide.

Why Colive -Not Just Another PG in Whitefield

Most PGs in Whitefield advertise the same checklist: furnished rooms, Wi-Fi, CCTV, housekeeping. The difference shows up in how reliably those things actually work, and in who you call when they don't. Colive operates as a fully managed residential brand rather than an individual landlord, and that distinction plays out in practical ways.

Professional Property Management

Every Colive property has a dedicated operations team. Maintenance requests are logged through the Colive app and resolved on tracked timelines -not a vague promise that the Wi-Fi will be fixed "tomorrow" for a week.

Transparent, All-Inclusive Billing

Your monthly rent covers Wi-Fi, power backup, housekeeping and maintenance. There are no surprise add-ons for utilities or cleaning appearing later in the month.

Digital-First Onboarding

Browsing rooms, uploading ID, signing the agreement and paying the deposit all happen in the app. Move-in is quick and paperwork is minimal.

Community, Not Just a Building

Colive properties run resident events and have shared lounges and co-working corners, so newcomers build a social circle quickly -genuinely underrated when you have just moved to a new city.

Zero Brokerage

No agent fees, no middlemen. What you see on colive.com is what you pay -across every locality Colive manages in the city.

Whitefield PG for Ladies -Safe, Modern, Well-Managed

Whether you need ladies PG in Whitefield, PG in Whitefield for ladies, PG for women in Whitefield, ladies PG in Whitefield Bangalore, or a PG for ladies near Whitefield -Colive's women-only properties include women-only floors, biometric access, 24/7 CCTV and trained female staff.

A ladies PG in Whitefield should deliver on safety in practice, not just on a banner. Colive's women's accommodation is built around controlled access and on-ground staffing: biometric or smart-card entry, women-only floors with strict access policies, 24/7 CCTV and trained female staff on site. Several properties sit close to Manipal Hospital Whitefield and the ITPL employment cluster, which suits both working women and students.

Key Features -Ladies PG in Whitefield

  • Women-only floors with strictly maintained access policies

  • Biometric / smart-card entry and round-the-clock CCTV monitoring

  • Trained female staff and a visitor-verification protocol

  • Community events for women residents, plus easy access to ITPL and the Whitefield Metro

Pricing for ladies PGs follows the same bands as the rate card further down this page. Room availability changes weekly, so check current listings before you visit.

Whitefield PG for Gents -Options, Features and Pricing

Colive's gents PGs in Whitefield are positioned for people with early commutes and long workdays near the IT corridor. Most properties are a short ride from ITPL, the EPIP Zone and GR Tech Park, with single, twin and triple-sharing rooms across budget and premium tiers.

Key Features -Gents PG in Whitefield

  • Single, double and triple-sharing rooms to suit different budgets

  • App-based facility management with tracked request resolution

  • 24/7 security with CCTV and biometric entry

  • High-speed Wi-Fi and co-working corners for remote or after-hours work

  • Optional hygienic meal plans, daily housekeeping and power backup

Couple-Friendly, Single and Unisex PGs in Whitefield

Beyond standard gents and ladies accommodation, Colive runs three options that traditional PGs rarely offer in Whitefield:

  • Couple-friendly PGs -private, comfortable stays for partners, with the paperwork handled cleanly and discreetly.

  • Single-occupancy rooms -full privacy for professionals who want their own space after work.

  • Unisex / co-living homes -mixed-gender residences built around shared lounges and a social, networked living style.

Life at a Colive PG in Whitefield

A Colive PG in Whitefield is built around what people actually need when they are managing a demanding job or a course in a new city. Mornings start with reliable Wi-Fi and an optional meal plan; evenings come with a co-working lounge you don't have to leave the building for. Weekends are short on logistics because Phoenix Marketcity, supermarkets and cafés are minutes away.

The honest difference between a good PG and a frustrating one is rarely the amenities list -it is whether those amenities work on a Tuesday night when something breaks. That is the part Colive's managed model is designed to get right: a logged request, a tracked timeline, and a team that answers.

faqs.heading: Frequently Asked Questions About PGs in Whitefield (General Queries)

items.question: What is the price of a PG in Whitefield?
items.answer: PG rent in Whitefield starts at about ₹6,500–₹8,000 a month for shared rooms and rises to ₹18,000–₹28,000+ for premium single occupancy. All Colive rates are all-inclusive -rent, Wi-Fi, utilities, security and maintenance -with no hidden charges.

items.question: Are Colive PGs in Whitefield fully furnished?
items.answer: Yes. Every room comes with a bed and mattress, wardrobe, study desk and storage as standard. Premium units add more space and amenities.

items.question: Which areas in Whitefield are best for a PG?
items.answer: Popular pockets are ITPL Road, Kadugodi, Hoodi, Channasandra, ECC Road and Varthur -all close to tech parks, metro stations and major offices.

items.question: How far is the Whitefield Metro from Colive PGs?
items.answer: Most Colive properties are a short ride from the Whitefield (Kadugodi), Hope Farm or Channasandra Purple Line stations, giving a direct metro link to KR Puram, Indiranagar and MG Road.

items.question: What is the security deposit for a PG in Whitefield?
items.answer: Most properties charge one to two months' rent as a refundable deposit, returned on move-out after adjusting for any actual damage.

items.question: Are there hidden charges at Colive PGs?
items.answer: No. Rent already includes utilities, Wi-Fi, housekeeping and maintenance. Any optional add-on, such as a meal plan, is communicated clearly up front.

items.question: Is a ladies PG in Whitefield safe?
items.answer: Yes. Colive women's PGs use 24/7 surveillance, biometric access, a visitor protocol, women-only floors and trained on-ground staff.

items.question: What facilities do ladies PGs offer?
items.answer: Furnished rooms, meals, Wi-Fi, housekeeping, laundry, a fitness corner, a community lounge and a tight security system.

items.question: Are there curfew timings at ladies PGs?
items.answer: Most ladies PGs keep reasonable entry timings for security. Colive's policies are designed to balance safety with flexibility -confirm specifics with on-site management.

items.question: What documents are required for admission?
items.answer: Usually Aadhaar or PAN, an office or college ID and passport-size photographs. The process is fully online.

items.question: Are working women and visitors allowed?
items.answer: Yes. Properties are well connected to the IT and commercial hubs, so they suit corporate professionals. Visitors are allowed with prior approval and verification.

items.question: How much does a ladies PG in Whitefield cost?
items.answer: Pricing follows the same bands as the rate card above, with all-inclusive billing -no brokerage, no heavy deposits and no separate utility bills.

items.question: Is a gents PG in Whitefield good for IT professionals?
items.answer: Yes. Most gents properties sit near ITPL, the EPIP Zone, GR Tech Park and Mindspace, which keeps the daily commute short.

items.question: What room-sharing options are available for men?
items.answer: Single, double, triple and four-sharing rooms, priced by your budget and privacy needs.

items.question: Are laundry and housekeeping included?
items.answer: Yes -both are part of the monthly rent.

items.question: Can parents or guardians visit residents?
items.answer: Yes. Parents can visit after completing verification as per property rules.

items.question: How is co-living different from a traditional PG?
items.answer: Traditional PGs often mean limited privacy and dated facilities. Co-living adds furnished spaces, smart security, community events, flexible leases and modern amenities under one roof.

items.question: Are Colive's co-living spaces tech-enabled?
items.answer: Yes -digital locks, app-based support, high-speed Wi-Fi and managed community spaces are standard.

items.question: Do the PGs allow flexible stays?
items.answer: Yes. Choose short or long-term stays, upgrade or downgrade as needed, or move between Colive properties.

items.question: How do I book a PG in Whitefield?
items.answer: Book directly on colive.com or the app: pick a property, check availability, choose your room type and confirm in a few minutes.
